def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    fit_mask = bins >= item
    priority_scores[fit_mask] = -(bins[fit_mask] - item)
    return priority_scores

    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    fit_mask = bins >= item
    fit_counts = np.floor(bins[fit_mask] / item)
    priority_scores[fit_mask] = -fit_counts
    return priority_scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining_space = bins - item
    return np.where(remaining_space >= 0, -remaining_space, -np.inf)
